title: Hilbert’s tenth problem over the rational numbers
summary: We give a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over the rational numbers: no algorithm decides whether a polynomial with integer coefficients has a rational zero. The number of variables is part of the input.

review.reason: Shows no algorithm decides rational zeros of integer polynomials, answering Hilbert's tenth problem.
